name: BuukEasy
description: A full-stack booking platform for solo beauty and wellness professionals.
longDescription: BuukEasy is a full-stack booking platform with secure payments and a mobile-first interface, built for solo beauty and wellness professionals. The MVP launched with booking and payment features and is currently serving 5 clients.

name: Adversarial Defense Optimization
description: A hybrid adversarial defense pipeline combining JPEG compression with DiffPure.
longDescription: Built a hybrid adversarial defense pipeline that applies JPEG compression before DiffPure to reduce purification cost. Benchmarked robustness against standalone DiffPure under standard and adaptive attacks on CIFAR-10.

name: Tracing Motion
description: A computer vision pipeline that transforms motion in video into Van Gogh-inspired animated artwork.
longDescription: Tracing Motion converts video into stylized motion artwork by extracting moving silhouettes with MOG2 background subtraction, estimating motion using Farneback optical flow, and generating flow-directed Van Gogh strokes, paint strokes, contour rings, and post-processing effects.
